evidence.reason: Valid. In the current `schema_problem`, lines 1088-1089 evaluate `_SCHEMA_TYPES[t]` for each declared `type` without first checking that the type name is one of the supported values. `type` is in `_SCHEMA_KEYWORDS`, so the keyword guard at line 1082 does not reject a rule such as `{"type": "number"}`; the lookup raises `KeyError` instead of returning the violation string the docstring promises ("returning the first violation with its location instead of raising"). `local_review_schema` returns the deployment-provided receipt rule without validating its type vocabulary, so a deployment schema using `number` on a property present in the sampled receipt crashes the validator and loses the receipt verdict and tick result. The smallest compatible fix is to return an unsupported-schema diagnostic when a type name is outside `_SCHEMA_TYPES`, preserving fail-closed behavior. This is a routine correctness repair, not a new requirement or an owner decision.
